summary: The verifier runs the documented command on sealed batches and compares the complete report against expectations that match the SOP and the retained shipped fallbacks. Each SOP rule and each 'keep today's calculation' fallback has an isolating fixture that rejects the shipped bug and the plausible alternatives. The comparator follows the tolerance and exact-field promises in the instruction. No false rejection or accepted wrong implementation was found.
checks_performed: Read every file in the packet manifest in full; no truncated ranges.
Compared ROSTER row counts with the actual JSONL line counts for all 19 families; all match.

Compared each ROSTER digest with the packet-manifest sha256 of the same expected file; all 19 match. Confirmed the verifier's shipped driver hash equals the environment driver hash (2b8b03b2...), so an unmodified driver passes test_driver_is_unchanged.

Hand-traced expected values against SOP sections 2-8 (static arithmetic, not execution) for: all of blank_mean, blank_nondetects, blank_single_result, blank_no_results, calibration rows 1 and 4, dilution, flag_basis, flag_limits, negative_readings, ccv_limits, ccv_bracketing, ccv_unbracketed, spike_recovery, spike_nondetects, report_order row 1 (per-analyte blank levels and CCV status), section_one_limits rows 1, 3, 6, 7, 8, 10, and generated-1 row 5 (spike recovery without dilution in the denominator). Traced every ccv_ok entry in capacity.jsonl against nearest-CCV-on-each-side and shipped fallbacks.

Mapped each shipped defect to the fixture that rejects it: through-origin fit (calibration), first-blank level (blank_mean/blank_nondetects), reading*dilution-level (dilution), flag on amount (flag_basis), strict unrounded CCV band (ccv_limits CCV-1/2/3/5), previous-CCV-only bracketing (ccv_bracketing W-111), added*dilution denominator (spike_recovery rows 1-2).

Checked plausible alternative wrong implementations: empty-mean->0 or mean-of-all-blank-readings when no blank results (blank_no_results rows 2-4 reject); unbracketed always true/false (ccv_unbracketed rows 1-2 reject); next-CCV-only or all-CCVs bracketing (ccv_bracketing W-112/W-113 reject); any-analyte CCV failure (report_order row 1 As/Cd, section_one row 9 Sb reject); SOP recovery applied to non-detects or zero for ND amounts (spike_nondetects reject); parent corrected reading times spike dilution (spike_recovery W-131T rejects); rounded reported CCV recovery (ccv_limits CCV-3 rejects); clamping negative blank readings (negative_readings row 1 W-103 rejects); floor instead of round (ccv_limits CCV-5 rejects).

Checked that fixtures respect the SOP section 1 domain: distance of limits from mdl/loq (1e-5 absolute / 1e-5 relative above one), CCV true >= 10*loq, CCV reading between 0.5x and 1.5x true, readings within +/-1e4, intercept <= 1e4*slope, slope >= 1e-12, rounding-tie clearance. Boundary rows reach but do not exceed these limits.

Checked the comparator (tests/test_outputs.py:119-142) against instruction.md:7: exact id/analyte/flag/ccv_ok/pass and list order; value as number or null; other numbers use 1e-6 relative, or 1e-6 absolute when |expected| < 1; blank_levels compared by key set, so key order is not enforced.

Checked the execution path: the verifier owns the driver copy, runs the documented command on a neutral path as an unprivileged user, and makes /app readable. The staged batch JSON round-trips floats exactly through json.dump(repr).

coverage_sweep.category: Map each required behavior to an assertion that fails if missing or reversed
coverage_sweep.reason: Each SOP section has a named test with an isolating family, and each family compares the full report.

coverage_sweep.category: Check the full core result, not existence/keys/row count
coverage_sweep.reason: compare() checks the top-level key set, list lengths, per-entry key sets and every field value, including blank_levels.

coverage_sweep.category: For each named domain rule, a case whose outcome changes when the rule is wrong
coverage_sweep.reason: Isolating hand-computable fixtures exist for: fitted intercept and IS normalization, mean of blank results anywhere, blank ND exclusion, single-result level, blank before dilution, flags on the corrected reading, rounded inclusive CCV band, unrounded reported recovery, nearest-both bracketing, and spike recovery against added. Fallbacks (no blank results, unbracketed runs, non-detect spikes/parents) have both sign partitions.
The shipped package and nine plausible alternative mis-implementations were statically traced to failing rows (see checks_performed).

coverage_sweep.category: Contract-valid alternatives accepted (formatting, ordering, implementation choices)
coverage_sweep.reason: Output is parsed JSON. blank_levels key order is ignored. int and float are both accepted for numbers. The tolerance matches the instruction. Flag and CCV thresholds are never exercised at an exact limit or rounding tie, so >= vs > and rounding-mode choices cannot change a grade. Readings stay well-conditioned enough that OLS formula variants remain within 1e-6.

coverage_sweep.category: Documented restrictions and lifecycle behavior enforced
coverage_sweep.reason: The 'leave driver byte-for-byte' promise is enforced by test_driver_is_unchanged using bytes read before replacement. No other lifecycle or dependency restriction is promised.
Runs before the first CCV (true), after the last CCV (previous CCV status, both pass and fail), and batches with no CCVs are all graded.

coverage_sweep.category: Signed derived quantities: sign partitions discriminated
coverage_sweep.reason: Covered: negative and positive blank levels, negative corrected readings, negative and positive intercepts, and negative and positive spike recoveries in both the SOP and fallback branches.

coverage_sweep.category: Proxy, stale binary, self-controlled comparison, Oracle-specific representation
coverage_sweep.reason: Expected reports are sealed, digest-pinned and unreadable to the candidate UID. The driver is the verifier's own copy. The candidate cannot influence the expectations. No representation beyond the SOP's JSON fields is imposed.

Boundary fixtures sit on or inside the SOP section 1 limits: slope 1e-12, intercept 1e4*slope, reading +/-1e4, mdl 0.0001, dilution 1000, 80 runs, 4 analytes, 8 standards, and near-limit values more than 1e-5 or 1e-5 relative from the limits.

interaction_sweep.case_or_path: All three combinations of spike and parent result status, with differing spike and parent dilutions, and the same parent used by two spikes.
A CCV that fails for some analytes and passes for others brackets multi-analyte samples and spikes. ccv_ok differs per analyte.

rules: SOP 4 per-analyte result status of blanks

The blank level is subtracted before dilution for both parent (x4) and spike (x8), giving recovery 380.
